headlines.summary: Stadtwerke Heidenheim cited GE Vernova's short delivery times and technical capabilities as key to keeping the wind project on schedule following unexpected delays and strict statutory deadlines.

headlines.summary: AI builders will not wait for the grid, so one company ships fuel cells to the fence line while another books turbines years ahead. Both stocks just got hammered, and only one has the cash to ride out what comes next.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Continues Wind Energy Expansion in Germany With New Order From Stadtwerke Heidenheim AG
headlines.summary: SALZBERGEN, Germany, November 09, 2026--GE Vernova (NYSE: GEV) announced today that it has signed an agreement with Stadtwerke Heidenheim AG to supply three of its 5.5 MW-158m onshore wind turbines for the Schlotberg-Jüchsen wind farm in Germany. The order includes a long-term service agreement of 20 years, underscoring the commitment of both companies to supporting Germany’s ambitious renewable energy goals.

headlines.summary: GE Vernova has had a volatile first stretch as a standalone stock, with a strong 1 year gain now bumping up against a sharp pullback and fresh headlines on buybacks, acquisitions and energy policy. description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
